title: [NatWest demo] Payments OTel - settlement-service consumer idle
description:
Reads OTel server spans (index=otel_traces sourcetype=otel:traces service.name=settlement-service kind=SPAN_KIND_SERVER) and counts the volume of consumer-side spans over the last 5 minutes. Fires one ITSI notable when the count drops below 3 (steady-state demo throughput is ~35-50 settlement spans per 5-min bin from the payment-initiation->Kafka->settlement async chain). The signal is a near-zero proxy for two scenarios where the Kafka pipeline breaks but the rest of the chain stays nominally healthy (no api-gateway 5xx, no ledger errors):
  - settlement-producer-off  (KAFKA_PRODUCER_ENABLED=false on payment-initiation-service - no messages reach the topic, settlement spans drop to ~0)
  - kafka-outage             (broker scaled to 0 - producer-side errors might also show up, but the consumer-side silence is the canonical signal)

Why 5 minutes rather than shorter: settlement-service runs a periodic poll loop, so transient blips (single missed poll, broker reconnect) are normal. A 5-minute window with count < 3 is a sustained "the topic is empty" condition, not a single-tick anomaly. Cohort_key groups all firings within the same 5-minute bin into one notable.

Service routing: "Ledger & Settlement Services" so the notable lands in the same Episode as ledger-service / postgres / kafka notables when a meltdown spans multiple layers.
search: index=otel_traces sourcetype="otel:traces" "service.name"=settlement-service kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER" | bin _time span=5m | stats count AS spans BY _time | where spans < 3 | eval severity = case(spans = 0, "5", true(), "4") | eval service = "Ledger & Settlement Services" | eval title = "settlement-service consumer idle (" . spans . " spans in 5 min)" | eval source = "Splunk ES - payments OTel" | eval cohort_key = "settlement_idle:" . strftime(_time, "%Y%m%d%H%M") | eval description = title . " - settlement Kafka chain is silent. Likely chaos: settlement-producer-off (KAFKA_PRODUCER_ENABLED=false on payment-initiation-service) or kafka-outage (broker scaled to 0). Cross-check chaos_injection_audit in the same Episode and the APM service map for a missing async edge between payment-initiation-service and settlement-service." | table _time, severity, service, title, source, spans, cohort_key, description
